connectorUiConfig.title: Dynatrace Attacks V3
connectorUiConfig.descriptionMarkdown: This connector uses the [Dynatrace DQL Storage Query API](https://docs.dynatrace.com/docs/platform/grail/dynatrace-query-language) to ingest detected application security attacks into Microsoft Sentinel Log Analytics. It queries the Dynatrace Grail platform using DQL to retrieve attacks detected in the last 2 hours, including attack type, risk level, targeted object, and attacker IP/geo information. Requires a Gen3 Dynatrace environment (xxx.apps.dynatrace.com), a platform token with the ***storage:security.events:read*** scope, and read access to the ***security.events*** Grail bucket.
connectorUiConfig.additionalRequirementBanner: This data connector depends on a parser based on Kusto Function to work as expected which is deployed with the Microsoft Sentinel Solution.

sampleQueries.query:
DynatraceAttacks
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by AttackId
| take 10

DynatraceAttacks
| where Severity == "High"
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by AttackId
| take 10

DynatraceAttacks
| where AttackType == "SQL_INJECTION"
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by AttackId
| take 10

DynatraceAttacks
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by AttackId
| summarize count() by sourceIp
| sort by count_ desc
| take 10

DynatraceAttacksV3_CL
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by event_id
| summarize count() by actor_geo_country_name
| sort by count_ desc
| take 10

resourceProvider.permissionsDisplayText: read and write permissions are required.

customs.name: Dynatrace Gen3 tenant (ex. xyz.apps.dynatrace.com)
customs.description: You need a valid Dynatrace Gen3 tenant (xxx.apps.dynatrace.com) with [Application Security](https://www.dynatrace.com/platform/application-security/) enabled. This connector does not support classic environments (xxx.live.dynatrace.com).

customs.name: Dynatrace Platform Token
customs.description: You need a Dynatrace platform token with the ***storage:security.events:read*** scope. See [Dynatrace platform tokens](https://docs.dynatrace.com/docs/manage/identity-access-management/access-tokens-and-oauth-clients/platform-tokens) for instructions.

customs.name: Dynatrace Grail Bucket Permissions
customs.description: The token's user or service account must have read access to the ***security.events*** Grail bucket. Grant this under **Settings → Identity & access management → Buckets** in your Dynatrace environment.

instructionSteps.title: Dynatrace Attack Events to Microsoft Sentinel
instructionSteps.description:
Configure and Enable Dynatrace [Application Security](https://www.dynatrace.com/platform/application-security/). 
 1. Create a platform token with the ***storage:security.events:read*** scope following [these instructions](https://docs.dynatrace.com/docs/manage/identity-access-management/access-tokens-and-oauth-clients/platform-tokens). 
 2. Grant the token's account read access to the ***security.events*** bucket under **Settings → Identity & access management → Buckets**. 
 3. Use your Gen3 environment URL in the format ***xyz.apps.dynatrace.com***.
